The '''Rescue Mission to Dibrook''' took place shortly after the [[Battle of Dibrook]]. Its goal was to free refugees captured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the battle.

==Prelude==
During the Battle of Dibrook the Yuuzhan Vong captured about thirty refugees housed aboard the [[Dibrook Space Station]], taking them to their [[Shaper research facility]] on the surface of [[Dibrook]]. When [[Kaye Galfridian]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'', learned of the kidnapping, she planned on rescuing them. The station's commander, [[Bylsma]], aided her with [[New Republic soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Environment suit/Legends|Enviro-suits]] to survive the hostile environment of Dibrook. They then set off in the ''Heart of Artorias'' to the planet. Due to the efforts of a [[yammosk]] trying to regain control of the former Yuuzhan Vong [[slaveship]], the ''Heart'' had to land far from the Yuuzhan Vong base.

==The Mission==
After the [[Army/Legends|army]], consisting of both [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] and the former [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from the ''Heart of Artorias'', had disembarked the ''Heart of Artorias'' and were on the planet's surface, a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Ogden (captain)|Ogden]], tried to take over control of the mission from Kaye Galdfridian and turn it from a rescue mission into an attack on the Yuuzhan Vong base. He was soon overpowered by [[Arbeloa]], Kaye's second-in-command, and the mission continued as planned.

When the army got near the base, they were attacked by a small group of [[thrall]]s, people implanted with [[Yorik-Kul|surge-coral]] to do the yammosk's bidding. Most of the attacking thralls were [[Death/Legends|killed]], but Kaye managed to subdue a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] thrall and had her escorted back to the ''Heart''.

After the thrall attack, the army sent out an advanced group of 50 soldiers, from both the ''Heart of Artorias'' and the New Republic, to scout ahead and gather intelligence on the Shaper research facility. Meanwhile, at the Yuuzhan Vong Base, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tsalok]] recommended that [[Master Shaper]] [[Nagme]] withdraw to [[Rychel]], while he would hold off the advance group.

Near the base, the two groups encountered each other, but despite their minority in soldiers, the Yuuzhan Vong quickly defeated the advance guard. The Yuuzhan Vong had captured a New Republic captain, and as a warning to the upcoming army Commander Tsalok tore off the captain's enviro-suit and ripped him in half. The Yuuzhan Vong then returned to their base, where Tsalok told Nagme to release her army of thralls.
